attempted_axis: Park-law-age reopen of the v4 park (2026-08-31T19:04:10Z) against claim.law.ternary-diamond-reaches-forward-branch-pair-at-cost-of-temp-result-register.20260831.v1 (21:42:44Z), which post-dates it by ~2.6h and explicitly claims the forward unfused branch pair is reachable ONLY as a ternary with the empty arm first. Two probes: (A) then-arm `goto done` with the real body as an explicit `else` arm (an if/else combination not in the v2/v3/v4 negative list, chosen because an explicit else should force the then-arm to materialise as its own basic block); (B) the law's prescribed shape, the whole dispatch rewritten as a ternary with the EMPTY arm first and the body carried as nested ternaries plus a comma expression.

attributes.decisive_finding: THE TERNARY LAW DOES NOT TRANSFER TO A DISCARDED-VALUE (void statement) CONTEXT. Probes A and B produced BYTE-IDENTICAL results to each other and to v4's axes B/C: real 4 -> 15, insns 32/31, multiset 4t -> 3t, same cluster `replace T[8:10]@20-28=['bge','b'] O[8:9]@20-24=['blt']`. That is two identical A/Bs, which kills the axis. The informative half is WHY the ternary failed here when it succeeded on CritterMoveSetup: there the ternary's value was ASSIGNED to a live local (`node = ...`), so the front end had to materialise a result register and a merge block, which is what splits the branch pair. DoPolyInst is void and the ternary's value is DISCARDED, so MWCC folds the empty arm away and re-emits the ordinary inverted single conditional `blt`. A SECOND, INDEPENDENT observation worth keeping: the nested ternaries reproduced the function's INNER if/else chain byte-for-byte (the fused inner guards at 0x34 `bne ->70` and 0x48 `bne ->68` survived unchanged), so MWCC normalises ternary and if/else to the same basic-block layout whenever the value is not consumed - the ternary is not a distinct lowering path in a void context. FREE EVIDENCE THAT PREDICTS THIS, and which no prior pass cited: DoPolyInst's OWN first guard `if (inst->_02 != 0) return;` compiles FUSED to a single `bne ->70` at 0x14. A void early-return guard in this very function fuses, which is the in-function positive control that the second guard's unfused pair cannot come from any void statement guard.
attributes.do_not_retry: Everything in v4's conclusion stands, now extended by two forms. Do NOT try any further if/goto/else/switch/do-while STATEMENT spelling: eight distinct portable-C forms across v2/v3/v4/v5 collapse to the identical `blt` result. Do NOT try the arm-swapped ternary in this or any other VOID function whose ternary value is discarded - measured inert here, and the mechanism (no result register is demanded, so the empty arm is folded) predicts it is inert for the whole class. The remaining lever is unchanged from v4: a WebFrank branch-form rule, the residual being 2 instructions, opcode-level, with identical semantics and no register or relocation component.
